summary: Revised implementation plan adding: (1) Android 8–10 full-screen visual leak and top/bottom cropping fixes across DialogEdgeToEdge, RootOverlay screens, Add/Edit Hotel & Account pages, History pages, and Settings sub-pages; and (2) upgraded Meal History page (left/right swipe + Summed vs. Adding-One-by-One Expression view modes with meal groups) plus a new matching Account History viewing page in the Extra/Account section.
